content.summary: An adult snowboard instructor proves glide, rail and one final jump. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

Hand off to a low rear follow; preserve helmet, goggles and shadow as the rider approaches one yellow rail. Accelerate toward one white ramp, launch once and hold the silhouetted grab against the sun before descent.
